summary: Polibeli Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that an indirect subsidiary entered a five-year cloud computing services agreement and initial service order with a Japanese customer on October 15, 2026. Total scheduled fees are approximately US$130.1 million over a 60-month service period, with a 20% prepayment due at signing credited against monthly invoices. Commencement depends on prepayment receipt, upstream service availability, and acceptance procedures; termination for convenience is barred. This is an ordinary commercial contract, not a special situation; no deal terms or board recommendation apply.
